title: Reader findings
description: reader-findings.json in the work folder: the judgements of the drawing-reader agent (what kind of drawing a sheet is, what a general-note item says, how the structure is organised, where two sources disagree), each tied to the text-index entries it rests on. Written only by `harness finding`; a report may print a number or a claim only when a finding (or another named artefact) carries it. A finding is accepted only when every cited entry exists, sits on the cited sheet and is not blocked by the legacy-font gate (text_gate.py: meaning is never taken from text whose encoding is unknown, proposed or contradicted); a blocked entry can only be quoted in a reader question (`harness ask`). `entries[].display_text` is copied verbatim from the text index when the finding is recorded. `confidence` is the minimum of the cited entries' confidence, optionally lowered by the reader, and is never 'high' (only an engineer answer is). `file_sha256` is the inventory's sha256 of the file at that time: a finding whose file has since changed is 'stale' (`harness finding list` shows it; the stored document does not). Ids F-001.. are allocated in increasing order from `next_id` and never reused; a withdrawn finding stays with its reason. Findings are ordered by id; the document has no timestamps.

next_id.description: N of the next id to allocate (F-N); greater than every allocated id.

display_text.description: The entry's display_text, copied verbatim when the finding was recorded.

kind.description: sheet_class: the kind of drawing a sheet is (value from the closed list below; 'mixed' = one sheet holding several drawings; 'other' needs a note). note_item: a verbatim quote from a general note, fields.topic says which topic. structural_system: the reader's claim about the structure, fields.aspect says which aspect. cross_check: a mismatch between sources, with at least two entries and at least one question.

file.description: Inventory path of the drawing file.

file_sha256.description: The inventory's sha256 of `file` when the finding was recorded.

sheet.description: Detector sheet id (model#01, <layout>#01) every cited entry is assigned to; null when the finding is not tied to one sheet (allowed for every kind but sheet_class).

entries.description: The cited entries, in the order given.

fields.description: note_item: topic (design_code, concrete_class, rebar_grade, steel_grade, bolt_grade, weld, cover, lap, convention, other). structural_system: aspect (frame_type, foundation_type, lateral_system, floors, typical_floors). Other keys are free (lowercase snake_case), values are strings.

questions.description: Registry question ids the finding relates to (required for cross_check).

confidence.description: Minimum of the cited entries' confidence, optionally lowered; never 'high'.
